page.overview:
Who is Gatekeeper?

The Gatekeeper was a giant fiddler crab that served as the guardian of the Moon's entrance.

The crab was both very dutiful and hostile in nature, attacking anyone or anything that came near the Moon entrance, except Toneri's puppets and presumably the Ōtsutsuki clan members.

Though resembling a normal crab, it was enormous in size. It had a red-coloured exoskeleton with yellow and blue stripes in its eight legs and two asymmetric pincers, along with many sharp teeth. It also had a white crown-like structure in its head.

This crab was able to use Water Release techniques such as the Water Release: Wild Water Wave technique. It also mastered a degree of genjutsu, as it was capable to trap its victims. Its enormous pincers made it capable to shred humans into pieces. It was also very durable, as its armour made the crab very difficult to kill.
